title: Cash taken offline that the server later refused disappears from the member's dues and the money counts
what: When a payment taken with no internet is refused once it is sent, it is kept only in the warning bar at the top. The member's page goes back to showing the full amount still owed, the 'payment still being sent' block no longer stops a second payment, the Today line of money waiting to send leaves it out, and the clear-offline-copy warning does not name it as money. The member already paid and holds a printed receipt.
expected: Money taken and printed for stays visible on the member's page as taken but not yet saved, blocks a second payment for the same plan, and is named with its amount in every count and warning until the owner settles it.
how_often: whenever an offline payment is refused, rare
fix_line: Show refused money on the member's page as taken but not saved, and count it in the waiting money and the clear warning

title: An owner can wipe a refused receipt that was already printed, leaving no record of the cash and a gap in the receipt numbers
what: For a refused offline payment the owner gets 'Remove from this device'. The confirm says only that it was never sent and will be gone. It does not say it is a receipt the member already holds or how much money it was. After removing, the cash has no record anywhere and that receipt number is simply missing, although the rest of the app keeps every cancelled receipt so the numbers never have a gap.
expected: A refused receipt can only be saved as a cancelled receipt with a reason, or the confirm names the amount and the receipt number and warns that the number will be missing from the receipt book.
how_often: rare, only after a refused offline payment
fix_line: Offer only Save as cancelled receipt for refused money, or name the amount and number in the confirm

title: A plan and payment for a new member the server refused are sent anyway after 30 days, making a receipt for nobody
what: When a new member added offline is refused, the plan sold and payment taken with them wait on the device. After 30 days the refused member is deleted from the device for privacy, but the plan and payment stay, and on the next send they go to the gym's records. The server does not check that the member exists, so the gym's money totals get a receipt and a plan that belong to no member, and no member page shows them.
expected: When a refused new member is removed, the plan and payment that wait with them are kept back for the owner to settle (save as cancelled, or attach to a real member), never sent on their own.
how_often: rare, a refused offline new member left 30 days
fix_line: Hold the waiting plan and payment with the member, and ask the owner before the member is removed

items.reason: Payment flows here are the desk's offline and retry saves: sale and payment follow the receipt rules, offline receipts use the desk's own series, a refused receipt can be saved cancelled or removed (finding 02), a refused member's sale goes out after 30 days (finding 03). Plan-ran-out words match the server's basic and read-only rules. Prices, trial and refund wording do not live in these folders.
No payment company test or live switch in these folders. The only made-up money is the demo gym, and it can never be put online as a real gym.

Failed: a refused offline payment drops out of dues and counts (finding 01). Pending: an unanswered online save is kept, blocks a second payment and cannot be printed until confirmed. Plan ran out: offline money is kept and waits; the existing finding FN-L5-server-database-2-03 covers the server refusing it. Cancelled: a void keeps the row and number.

Import preview runs the real import on a copy, so its total matches what is saved; demo plan savings add up; an online save that is renumbered was never printable. Mismatch found: the Today waiting-money line and the clear warning leave out refused cash (finding 01).
